newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists allocated 250 bln lire of Italy CTZ.
newsitem.headline: Specialists allocated 250 bln lire of Italy CTZ.

text.p: Specialist bond traders were allocated 250 billion lire of two-year zero coupon certificates (CTZ) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 250 billion lire worth and bids for 364 billion lire.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 5.84 trillion lire at the open auction for the October 31, 1998 paper, against 2.5 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 89.10 from 89.10 at the previous CTZ sale on November 26. Gross yield was 6.31 percent against 6.17 percent.
